name: design
description: Design system funnel — 7 skills. Verb 0 detail (read-only, no artifact) explains the map of the funnel and routes a stated intent to one of six stack-agnostic case classes, extended by the platform workflow of the matching sc-* pivot when installed: route READS the pivot's ## Phases table and emits one merged sequence, each off-funnel phase landing at the position it declares (avant/après <verb>, or fin) — a phase whose anchor verb is absent from the resolved class is dropped and the omission stated, and unmet capabilities are emitted with the phases they block. The 5-verb pipeline define · destructure · adjust (freeze the 5-artifact contract — tokens.json, components.json, policies.json, oracle.json, deviations.json — rooted by release.json, migrate 1.x) · enforce (portable linter derived from the contract + sc-* pivot + 4 vocabulary gates: tokens.css import, generation rules, plan success_condition, pre-commit) · diffuse (elements under gate + sc-* pivot), plus harness (standalone mockup scaffold, outside the funnel: page keys are validated slugs that must derive a unique valid JS function name, the 0/2/3 exit space holds across the whole program and not only under --contract, the generated chrome is labelled and its page render has an error state instead of propagating to the oracle, the device bezel is an outline and never a border so a sample's content box keeps the sample width the fidelity oracle measures against, and a --contract stylesheet is confined to the contract directory and refused when it closes the <style> context; proven by a selftest that EXECUTES the generated file instead of grepping it, wired into the marketplace test chain; the three-branch page-key invariant — registry, <option> value, oracle reference_page — is machine-checked on any file, filled or scaffolded, by harness-runtime-check.mjs, and each branch is proven by a mutation the check must turn red). A 5th gate of a different nature measures rendering fidelity against the resolved mockup. Every contract carries a computed maturity status (extracted · normalized · validated · production-ready) that gates conformity: run-gates.py exits 4 below the threshold and every known gap caps the status instead of being recorded as prose; contrast is computed per theme at freeze on the foreground/background pairs the components declare, and declarative interactive states are checked without markup. A contract where no pair is constructible is refused at freeze rather than passed on an empty verdict: a failing ratio caps maturity, an unmeasurable one blocks until the pairing is declared or a three-part derogation is recorded. Adds copycat (per-page mockup→contract reconciliation agent + Python fidelity oracle: machine CLOSED/OPEN verdict, structural completeness scan, coverage guard, deviation-ledger with id + registry validation, ledger-unused detection, active-frame isolation, check_text per-target, collections LCS-diff, collection-level ack, visual-diff companion). Adds config-gen.py (contract → oracle config) and migrate-contract.py (1.x → 2.0). Platform-level workflows live in the sc-* pivots under a skeleton frozen by the pivot contract. BREAKING 2.0.0: the monolithic contract is split into components.json, policies.json, oracle.json and release.json; the linter reads the new format only and exits 3 on a 1.x contract.
